title: Signal: Refresh header redirects to an absolute URL
scope: One response: Refresh carries a URL target.
limitations: Observation-level: reads the Refresh header only. Meta-refresh markup inside a body is a different evidence shape and is not reported by this check. Any absolute or protocol-relative target matches, including a same-host https target, because the header alone cannot show where the value came from; this is the broad "Refresh navigation present" question. DPK-DAST-110 (plaintext target) and DPK-DAST-118 (protocol-relative target) report the two shapes that are unsafe on their own and also match here, so a downgrade produces both this review row and the specific finding.
fpNotes: A deliberate splash page that refreshes to a fixed same-site document is reported by design.
